description: REQUIRES prior nps_edi__auth__npki_session__login call with same account_link_id. Send the NPS membership certificate application (form EB0301) for 1 to 100 subscribers. Do this before the issue tool: the issue screen lists subscribers only under a received application document number. IRREVERSIBLE: a sent application cannot be cancelled and stays in the institution's records. Each subscriber needs member_name and rrno (13-digit resident registration number; never echoed back). Call without confirm first to get a preview (names and the last 4 digits only), show it to the user, then retry with confirm=true. Never set confirm=true on your own.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm.description: Set true ONLY after showing the preview to the user and receiving their explicit approval. Omit it on the first call to obtain the preview.

subscribers.description: 신청 대상자 목록(1명 이상 100명 이하). 대상자마다 성명과 주민등록번호를 넣는다

member_name.description: 대상자 성명. 기관이 확인한 성명과 다르면 신청서를 보내지 않는다

rrno.description: 대상자 주민등록번호(외국인등록번호) 13자리. 하이픈을 넣어도 된다. 응답과 증적에는 싣지 않는다

name: nps_edi__b1__certificates__membership__apply
title: 가입증명 신청서 발송
